sample: Six metadata-selected scenes with exactly one 2D/3D annotated bottle and table; prior selections excluded with a 30-index gap. Index spacing does not prove room independence.
annotation_rule: Before inspecting depth or 3D centers, inspect RGB and annotated 2D boxes. For the annotated bottle/table pair mark visible support true, false, or uncertain and record other plausible support surfaces. Preserve all six scenes in count summaries.

frozen_methods.detector: Grounding DINO Tiny, separate 'a bottle' and 'a table' prompts, box/text threshold 0.25
frozen_methods.segmenter: SAM ViT-B prompted by detected boxes, same-class mask IoU >= 0.7 deduplication
frozen_methods.depth: Depth Anything V2 Metric Hypersim Small, official camera intrinsics, no scale fitting
frozen_methods.object_matching: Class-aware box IoU >= 0.5 against the uniquely annotated pair, scoring only
frozen_methods.proposal: Bottle box-bottom center inside table box and absolute predicted median-depth gap <= 0.75m; one nearest parent per bottle
frozen_methods.mask_gate: Visible child lower-contour / parent SAM mask adjacency fraction > 0 within 8 vertical pixels
frozen_methods.correction: Fixed child-only camera-ray soft correction with 0.4m center-height offset and <=0.5m shift, if exactly one gated proposal; no tuning on these scenes

primary_outcomes: Positive annotated-pair proposal coverage before and after gate, denominator all RGB-certain positive scenes
Per-scene and mean bottle 3D center error on positive matched pairs: masked uncorrected vs masked corrected; report correction count and abstentions
Any scene-level proposal on RGB-certain negative annotated pairs, with alternate parent validity adjudicated separately
secondary_outcomes: Paired detector coverage over all six scenes
Box vs SAM mask center error
Counts of uncertain and alternate-support scenes
claim_limits: Six scenes and one visual annotator; object co-occurrence is not support ground truth. Fixed 0.4m offset chosen in earlier cup work and may be inappropriate for bottles. Alternative supports may be missing from annotations.
